title: Freya and the Crown
author: Noor Voss
blurb: Ulyana Pemberton, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
